rows.title: Workspace management and appearance
rows.baseline_behavior: Add folders, open-workspace picker, copy workspace path, remove from Orbit sidebar, choose curated icon and semantic tint; active/running/archived glyph fallback.
rows.baseline_edge_state: Removing a workspace is not deleting its folder or session files. marks validate known assets, persist with workspace list, and resolve tint against active theme.
rows.fixture: Two temporary workspaces, an isolated HOME/PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, fixture session JSONL files and controllable Pi RPC children.

steps.action: Add, rename, recolor and remove a temporary workspace using row menus; inspect its icon and active highlight.
steps.expected: Add folders, open-workspace picker, copy workspace path, remove from Orbit sidebar, choose curated icon and semantic tint; active/running/archived glyph fallback.

steps.action: Cancel removal, select a missing workspace, and exercise a linked worktree with the same repository root.
steps.expected: Removing a workspace is not deleting its folder or session files. marks validate known assets, persist with workspace list, and resolve tint against active theme.

steps.expected: Compare with the linked Rust handler using the same fault. Preserve its documented guard and error state: Removing a workspace is not deleting its folder or session files. marks validate known assets, persist with workspace list, and resolve tint against active theme.
